description: Transposes and inverts a polyphonic V/OCT signal, with trigger inputs that switch the transposition and the inversion on and off

params.text: Transposes by whole octaves, four octaves down to four octaves up
Transposes by seven semitones either way, in semitone steps
Raises the transposition by a quarter tone, which puts quarter-tone intervals within reach of the two transpose knobs
Turns inversion on; with it off nothing is ever inverted, and with it on the incoming voltage is flipped about 0V before the transposition is added

inputs.text: A trigger flips the inversion between on and off while the INV button is on; with nothing patched here the inversion is applied the whole time that button is on
A trigger flips the transposition between applied and not applied; with nothing patched here the transposition is applied the whole time
The polyphonic V/OCT signal to transpose and invert, every channel treated the same way

outputs.text: The transposed and inverted signal, carrying as many channels as the input

notes: the module makes no signal of its own. With nothing patched into the input the output carries no channels at all, and the knobs and buttons change nothing
there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
